scope: Independent defensive read-only review of upload/download storage, restore/export boundaries, configured model destinations, resource limits, subprocess/deserialization and documented security posture. Application source unchanged.
method: Read repository source and existing tests/dated audit evidence; independently compare source hashes in root synthetic proof records. No HTTP/network/model calls, no tests/tools against a running application, no live secrets/config/DB/uploads/backups/model reads. Only this new documentation JSON written.

findings.verification: Source defect plus exact extraction-command behavior independently reviewed from root synthetic results; full restore not exercised.
findings.weakness: The matching media tar is extracted into dirname(UPLOADS_DIR), without requiring every archive member to belong to the expected upload subtree. Database verification does not validate companion archive membership or integrity. The database swap precedes media extraction.
prerequisites: Write access to the backup companion archive or a malicious supplied backup set.
Operator invokes standby restore and its existing database/key/schema/live-primary guards permit installation.
The restore process has permission to write the target parent directory.

root_observation.scope: Exact extraction command only, owned harmless fixture; full restore/gating not exercised.

technical_limits: Observed replacement was one harmless synthetic sentinel outside uploads, using an ordinary archive member; no traversal or symbolic link was required.
The whole restoration script, valid encrypted backup guards and database replacement were not run in this check.
No unauthenticated remote endpoint or remote code execution was demonstrated.
existing_defenses: SQLCipher backup verification, schema/table checks, primary guard, private scratch copy and previous database generation exist.
recommended_normal_regressions: Reject any archive member outside the expected upload subtree, including harmless sibling files.
Reject archive links/special entries and impose expanded-size/member limits before writes.
Verify failure leaves existing database/media intact or accurately reports partial recovery; test the complete guarded script separately.

findings.verification: Source defect plus root synthetic QR creation under controlled umask.
findings.weakness: QR generation writes the raw bearer-link image through img.save(path), bypassing encrypted/private media publication. File creation permissions follow the inherited umask.
prerequisites: A discharge link is issued and a QR file is generated.
A local account can traverse the containing upload directory or access a copied/upload backup artifact.
technical_limits: 0644 plaintext PNG was verified only with synthetic URL, umask022 and synthetic upload encryption configured.
Actual appliance directory permissions were not inspected; a private parent directory may prevent other-user access.
The HTTP QR route remains authenticated and patient-scoped; the discharge portal requires its additional DOB/grant controls. No portal access or real token disclosure was attempted.
existing_defenses: High-entropy link token and hashed database token storage.
Authenticated patient-scoped QR response and portal verification.
recommended_normal_regressions: Verify private creation from first byte under permissive umask and authenticated read compatibility.
Verify QR storage observes the declared upload encryption policy without exposing a plaintext intermediate.

findings.verification: Static data-flow confirmation only; no worker process or process-list observation executed.
findings.weakness: The subprocess transcription fallback passes hints containing patient name, diagnosis, medicines and attending clinician as an argv entry.
prerequisites: A patient-specific transcription selects the subprocess fallback.
Another local principal or process-inventory/logging tool can inspect this process command line.
technical_limits: No claim that any particular OS account can inspect command lines was dynamically tested.
subprocess.run receives an argument list and does not use shell=True; this is confidentiality exposure, not shell injection.
No model, real patient context or process inventory was read.
existing_defenses: The route scopes the patient before constructing hints.
Model gating, bounded execution timeout and private temporary audio conversion exist.
recommended_normal_regressions: Capture subprocess arguments for synthetic hints and assert no clinical text appears in argv.
Transmit bounded synthetic context through private stdin/framed IPC and verify success/failure cleanup and protocol validation.

findings.verification: Root isolated authenticated Lens denial and controlled failed-stream checks; full Scribe retention is source-only.
findings.weakness: Lens publishes the upload before patient authorization. Denial, failed inference and failed save/cancellation have no owned-file cleanup in this flow. Full Scribe transcription similarly retains its published file after a caught ASR failure.
prerequisites: An authenticated caller has the relevant media feature permission.
Lens is explicitly enabled, or the applicable Scribe/model lane is enabled.
technical_limits: The denied Lens file was encrypted and mode0600. This finding is staging/retention behavior, not an encryption bypass or successful cross-department media read.
Unauthenticated control returned401 and created no file.
The failed-stream response had HTTP200 because SSE headers were already sent, and correctly contained a terminal error; the file retention is the defect.
Repeated disk exhaustion, Scribe failure/cancellation retention and cleanup across crashes were not dynamically tested.
existing_defenses: 25MiB image/100MiB audio per-file limits, streamed total-body limits and server-generated safe filenames.
Private atomic encrypted writes and typed generic error responses.
recommended_normal_regressions: Assert an out-of-scope request never publishes a file.
Assert failed/cancelled inference or record-save removes only its owned unregistered file, including delayed worker completion.
Retain successful referenced media and preserve encryption/private modes.

findings.verification: Static configuration-to-transport confirmation only; no network request or URL probing executed.
findings.weakness: The backend accepts arbitrary ORB_OLLAMA_BASE_URL without local HTTP destination validation and uses it for clinical prompts. The startup wrapper skips remote/malformed daemon startup but continues launching the backend with the unchanged configured value. Strictly on-appliance/offline prose is therefore not an enforced transport invariant.
prerequisites: Operator environment/configuration points the model endpoint outside the approved local boundary, or that configuration is compromised.
technical_limits: No unauthenticated request-controlled model URL setter was identified. This is not a confirmed caller-controlled SSRF exploit.
The config source explicitly mentions a remote GPU box, so an approved LAN mode would need a stated policy rather than silently treating every remote value as an attack.
No DNS, redirects, proxies, remote endpoints or live environment values were probed.
existing_defenses: Owned daemon launcher enforces loopback/no-cloud/no-prune controls.
HTTPX model clients use trust_env=False; model-off guards run before inference.
recommended_normal_regressions: Define approved offline destination policy and validate configuration before constructing every provider/gateway client.
Use synthetic mocked transports to verify remote/malformed/userinfo/unsupported-scheme values are rejected before transport, while supported loopback variants remain usable.

findings.verification: Static parser/control-flow confirmation; no truncated-stream regression or model inference executed by this reviewer.
findings.weakness: Lens ignores malformed JSON frames and treats natural EOF as completion without requiring done:true or checking done_reason=length. Nonempty partial output can receive a disclaimer and be stored as a successfully completed unfiled analysis.
prerequisites: Lens explicitly enabled and permitted caller submits an image.
The local model transport returns nonempty partial or length-truncated output without a proper successful terminal frame.
technical_limits: No remote model attack, chart filing or clinical decision was demonstrated.
The investigational disclaimer and separate clinician review/assignment workflow remain in place.
Root failed-stream cleanup check uses a controlled service failure seam; it does not itself verify this parser-level EOF behavior.
existing_defenses: Empty output and explicit error frames raise; routes emit generic terminal SSE errors.
Saved analyses begin unfiled and carry the investigational disclaimer.
recommended_normal_regressions: A normal fake model stream must include a valid successful terminal frame.
Nonempty EOF, malformed JSON, wrong-shape frames, explicit errors and length termination must not persist a completed analysis.
Verify release/connection cleanup and preserved disclaimer on valid completion.

root_proof_references.preservation_limit: Raw root proof paths are owned temporary artifacts; root owns durable packaging and the combined review report. These notes do not claim permanent log retention of those temporary paths.

defenses_observed.control: Uploaded media resolves under the configured root and registered patient-linked media gets canonical patient authorization; this does not certify the separately reviewed unfiled-owner branch.
Media reads require durable fail-closed PHI audit and return non-executable attachment/octet-stream handling.
Encrypted media publication stages privately, flushes/fsyncs, atomically replaces and cleans failed staging; existing symlink destination is replaced rather than followed.
Declared file ceilings and actual received-byte counting bound individual requests; this is not a disk quota or cross-request cleanup guarantee.
Runtime dense/reranker adapter selects existing local weights with local_files_only, no remote custom code and weights_only=True.
Reviewed CoreML checkpoint loader uses weights_only=True. No model payload or deserialization was executed.

delegated_review: Scribe mutation/revision authorization, shared-ward downtime disclosure, tablet revocation parity and unfiled-media ownership were sent to the backend reviewer/root. Root authorization proof records cover several of these; they are not re-counted as additional independent findings in this six-item storage/operations note.

apple_production.scope: Complete resolved metadata, including Mac speech dependencies; not proof that native speech packages ran or were installed in the slim test environment.

javascript.scope: Prior npm lockfile metadata advisory query; not a new installed package scan.

limits: Advisory results are previously recorded known-vulnerability snapshots, not a fresh review-time registry check or proof of absence of vulnerabilities.
No shared/live environment was inspected or upgraded; existing old environments may retain historical vulnerable packages.
Hosted Linux CI and native Mac speech execution are separate acceptance boundaries.
Severity depends on the explicitly stated actor/configuration/operator prerequisite; no anonymous remote archive attack is claimed.
Storage retention is distinct from encryption: the root Lens denial retained encrypted0600 content.
Root isolated checks establish only their recorded seam/command behavior; untested hypotheses and complete operational pipelines are not promoted to verified outcomes.
No application source, existing evidence manifest, clinical policy or deployment setting was modified.
